envelope.description: Integrate code review preparation across routes

body.title: Integrate code review preparation across routes
body.summary: Route admission, packet projection, task/story execution and explicit recovery through shared preparation, preserving all selected spans and pinned history. Deliver private adapters consumed by existing coordinator/worker dependency seams and exercise them in focused integration fixtures. Production runtime selection is activated only in the coordinated t12 cutover after host and lifecycle dependencies exist.
acceptanceChecks: Through the shared family adapter, Epic/standalone/ISSUE/LLD-only/no-document routes and aliases preserve exact scope; no generic HEAD diff or skipped modules; immutable attempts remain pinned.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

This task gates the complete family adapter and its focused tests, not default production selection. It must expose execution/recovery seams for t9/t12; full production activation is mandatory in t12 and independently qualified in t13. No feature flag, parallel review engine or incomplete production cutover.

tests.name: Extend route-admission/projection-lineage/final-scope tests: all workflow story/task routes, merge/rename/delete witnesses, aliases and exact selected after blocks.
